in_sanskrit.name: विनोध
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Vinodha is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vinoda' which means 'joy, delight, pleasure, or beauty'. It is a feminine name and is often used to describe someone who brings joy and happiness to others.

in_hindi.name: विनोधा
in_hindi.meaning: विनोद (joy, delight, pleasure, or beauty) + ा (feminine suffix)
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Vinodha in Hindi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vinoda' which means 'joy, delight, pleasure, or beauty'. The feminine suffix 'ā' is added to the end of the word to make it a female name.

in_tamil.name: வினோதா

in_telugu.name: వినోదే
